nodes.title: The design revamp's phase 2 starts on direction A, 'Paper and ink', as the default theme, with direction B kept as a complete second theme that swaps the same tokens by one root attribute. The owner had not chosen on the comparison page in a day and had said the call on the UI was the main loop's; A is the Design session's recommendation and the main loop's. The lesson screen on a phone is built first and shown to the owner on production behind a switch before the rest. Brief: docs/design/round8/PHASE2-BRIEF.md. The teacher's look stays the owner's choice. Reverse if: the owner, shown the lesson screen, prefers B (B's theme is polished, A stays as the alternate) or prefers the current look (only the non-taste fixes are kept).
